title: Clo Brazil Workshop Highlights
description:
We are very happy to share with you the best moments of our first in-person Workshop in Brazil!

We held this event in partnership with the Centro Universitário Belas Artes, at Campus Cidade Jardins, in São Paulo. During four intensive days, we had the unique opportunity to teach our students in person, and the results were incredible!

Would you like to participate in a Workshop offered by the CLO Brasil team?

Fill out our interest form and be the first to know about upcoming courses: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1-FyCPeFnb3DlEGdqEpUH0jbrx2sd38jDrtsp0yelhQY/edit

See you soon!
transcript: Clow is already a software for the fashion industry, so we have tools to think, to weave. I came to the workshop, I have my expectations up there, I learned a lot for the first day and let's see how it will be in the next few days. The face-to-face workshop is something that we have been wanting to do for some time, because we did two virtual workshops, we had a very good acceptance from the community. We pointed out with the Belas Artes partnership, so we used all the infrastructure that they have here, the campus of Cidade Jardim. It was a very beautiful experience, precisely because 3D is starting here in the fashion area in Brazil and we are experiencing a revolution together with the Claw software and being able to see and be part of this moment in which people are learning the software. And using it to improve their knowledge in the fashion area and develop themselves, both in the industry and as freelancers, it is being very gratifying for all of us. We finally arrived on the last day of the course and my expectations were more than met. I loved it. At first I thought the software would be a little difficult, but I realized that it is super intuitive and that you can learn very quickly. I was very happy to have developed so many pieces in such a short time. In four days I practically developed a capsule collection, the top part, the bottom part and even the male part. And this workshop was an incredible experience so that we could have face-to-face contact with our students, with our users and see personally how the software tools motivate people to always learn more, get out of the comfort zone, for different things and new technologies.
summary: # Clo Brazil Workshop Highlights ## Introduction to Clow Software Clow is already a software for the fashion industry, offering tools that enable creative thinking and design. I came to the workshop with high expectations, and I learned a lot on the first day. I'm eager to see how the next few days unfold. ## Face-to-Face Workshop Experience The face-to-face workshop is something we've been wanting to do for some time. Previously, we conducted two virtual workshops, which received very good acceptance from the community. In partnership with Belas Artes, we utilized their infrastructure here at the Cidade Jardim campus. ## The Significance of 3D in Fashion This event was a beautiful experience, especially since 3D technology is just beginning to take off in the fashion sector in Brazil. We are experiencing a revolution alongside the Clow software, witnessing firsthand how people are learning to use it to enhance their knowledge in fashion. ## Empowering the Fashion Community Participants are developing their skills, both in the industry and as freelancers, which has been incredibly gratifying for all of us involved. ## Final Reflections on the Workshop As we arrived on the last day of the course, my expectations were more than met. I loved it! Initially, I thought the software would be challenging, but I realized that it is super intuitive, and you can learn very quickly. ## Achievements During the Workshop I was thrilled to have developed so many pieces in such a short time. In just four days, I practically created a capsule collection, including the top part, the bottom part, and even the male section. ## The Value of Personal Interaction This workshop provided an incredible opportunity for face-to-face contact with our students and users. It was inspiring to see how the software tools motivate people to continuously learn, step outside their comfort zones, and engage with new technologies.
